session_note: Alabama's 2026 Regular Session (constitutionally capped at 30 legislative meeting days within a 105-calendar-day window, Ala. Const. Amend. 57 / Art. V, Sec. 122) convened 2026-01-13 (legislative day 1) and adjourned sine die on 2026-04-09 (legislative day 30, 87 calendar days after convening), per ALISON's own legislative-day calendar for session '2026RS'. Alabama does not carry individual bills forward into a new year -- any bill not enacted by that sine die date is dead and would require reintroduction in a future session.
